key_insight: A transfer-learned, uncertainty-aware transformer can screen and rank greener solvent substitutes from scarce data with strong performance on key solubility descriptors.
engineering_relevance: The tool supports rapid solvent selection for organic photovoltaics and other emerging materials workflows, helping replace hazardous solvents with eco-friendlier options.
method: Pre-trained a foundation model on QM9 targets and transferred it to solvent-property prediction with minimal new data.
Added uncertainty quantification so users can assess confidence in each predicted solvent ranking.
Deployed the model as an easy-to-integrate screening tool for high-throughput lab workflows.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong prediction quality on well-studied targets like Hansen solubility parameters and dielectric constant, and high performance even on sparse targets such as Gutmann donor/acceptor numbers.
watch_item: Predictions still depend on the quality and domain coverage of the small target-property datasets, so confidence estimates and experimental validation remain important.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
